cond_0001.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through difficult or ambiguous client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research experience managing the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Knowledge of and/or experience with quantitative methodologies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Ability to tie research to client business goals and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Exceptional attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture.
Strong communication and listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and deliver reliable results on time and on budget.
Ability to internalize and apply basic concepts and guidance received, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater autonomous responsibility.
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!

Candidates should be developing strategists with hands-on primary marketing research experience, preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context, who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and help the team develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To contribute effectively, this individual must be highly analytical, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to share learnings across multiple projects.
Coordinate with team members to manage the research process from start to finish, including developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors.
Contribute initial thinking and frameworks that support the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and work alongside the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Help keep multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, flag issues early, and solve problems together.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ambiguous or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to give and receive constructive feedback to improve shared performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research experience, including managing the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting
Knowledge of quantitative methodologies and experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate impactful consumer insights through thought-provoking headlines
Attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture — able to manage the little things that have a large impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors
Commitment: ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and ensure reliable results on time and on budget
Preferred Requirements
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business goals and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable
Learning and application: can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater responsibility
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.)
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!

Candidates should be developing strategists with hands-on primary marketing research experience, preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context, who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0081.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and help the team develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To contribute effectively, this individual must be highly analytical, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to share learnings across multiple projects.
Coordinate with team members to manage the research process from start to finish, including developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors.
Contribute initial thinking and frameworks that support the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and work alongside the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Help keep multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, flag issues early, and solve problems together.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ambiguous or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to give and receive constructive feedback to improve shared performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0081.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research experience, including managing the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting
Knowledge of quantitative methodologies and experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate impactful consumer insights through thought-provoking headlines
Attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture — able to manage the little things that have a large impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors
Commitment: ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and ensure reliable results on time and on budget
Preferred Requirements
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business goals and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable
Learning and application: can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater responsibility
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.)
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!

Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0107.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will own primary quantitative research that advances clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and drive the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To succeed, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Lead the research process from start to finish, including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and directing fieldwork and vendor management in conjunction with other team members.
Develop initial thinking and frameworks that drive compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Own analytic plan development and execute advanced analytics with the team (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Proactively advise clients in close coordination with senior team members and account leads, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and resolve problems.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, taking initiative to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0107.requirements:
Primary marketing research (experience/interest in managing the full market research cycle including survey design; fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, and development of recommendations; reporting and presenting)
Quantitative methodologies (knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as: segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing)
Analytical thinking (experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate the research finding, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines)
Strategic thinking (able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable)
Attention to detail (without losing sight of the big picture able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project)
Communications (exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors)
Commitment (ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget)
Learning + application (can demonstrate basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working)
In sum, we are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and also has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

cond_0218.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should have hands-on primary marketing research experience, preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context, and be data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0218.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through difficult or ambiguous client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0218.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in primary marketing research, including proven ability to manage the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Deep knowledge of quantitative methodologies across a range of market research studies, such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Strong command of analytical thinking — extensive experience analyzing data and translating findings into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research results and generate impactful consumer insights through thought-provoking headlines.
Proven ability in strategic thinking — able to tie research directly to client business objectives and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Exceptional attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture, with a track record of managing the details that have a significant impact on overall project experience and outcomes.
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional communication skills, including outstanding listening ability; proven capacity to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; and demonstrated effectiveness in liaising with clients and vendors.
Strong commitment and resourcefulness — a track record of navigating challenges, finding solutions, and delivering reliable results on time and on budget.
Demonstrated ability to internalize concepts and guidance and apply them independently, building foundations that support exposure to more complex projects and greater autonomous responsibility.
We are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

cond_0226.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record and a passion for finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0226.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as a part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics, (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0226.requirements:
Primary marketing research (experience/interest in managing the full market research cycle including survey design; fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, and development of recommendations; reporting and presenting)
Quantitative methodologies (knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as: segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing)
Analytical thinking (experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate the research finding, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines)
Strategic thinking (able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable)
Attention to detail (without losing sight of the big picture able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project)
Communications (exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors)
Commitment (ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget)
Learning + application (can demonstrate basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working)
In sum, we are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and also has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

cond_0234.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record and interest in finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Coordinate the research process from start to finish, including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors together with other team members.
Contribute initial thinking and frameworks that support the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and work alongside the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Help manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work closely with senior team members and account leads to advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems together.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through difficult or ambiguous client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to give and receive constructive feedback to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0234.requirements:
Primary marketing research (experience/interest in managing the full market research cycle including survey design; fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, and development of recommendations; reporting and presenting)
Quantitative methodologies (knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as: segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing)
Analytical thinking (experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate the research finding, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines)
Strategic thinking (able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable)
Attention to detail (without losing sight of the big picture able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project)
Communications (exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors)
Commitment (ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget)
Learning + application (can demonstrate basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working)
In sum, we are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and also has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and set the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To succeed, you must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Own the research process end to end — from developing surveys based on client objectives, through testing programs, to managing fieldwork and vendors alongside other team members.
Deliver initial thinking and frameworks that drive compelling, visual report narratives built for insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Lead analytic plan development and direct the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget, applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Proactively advise clients in close coordination with senior team members and account leads — thinking ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of issues, and resolve problems decisively.
Maintain calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating ambiguous or difficult client situations.
Act as an effective peer collaborator and a mentor to junior strategists, taking ownership of giving and receiving constructive feedback to raise performance.
Drive contributions to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research: experience managing the full market research cycle, including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Quantitative methodologies: knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business needs and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Attention to detail: able to manage the small details that have a large impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project, without losing sight of the big picture.
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors.
Preferred Requirements
Commitment: ability to leverage available resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and deliver reliable results on time and on budget.
Learning and application: can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater autonomous responsibility.
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

cond_0251.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will own primary quantitative research that advances clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and drive the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To succeed, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Lead the research process from start to finish, including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and directing fieldwork and vendor management in conjunction with other team members.
Develop initial thinking and frameworks that drive compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Own analytic plan development and execute advanced analytics with the team (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Proactively advise clients in close coordination with senior team members and account leads, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and resolve problems.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, taking initiative to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.

cond_0274.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record and a passion for finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quantitative data and how it connects to brand and business questions.
cond_0274.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as a part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics, (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0274.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research: experience managing the full market research cycle including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting and presenting.
Quantitative methodologies: knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Analytical thinking: experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Strategic thinking: able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Attention to detail: without losing sight of the big picture, able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project.
Preferred Requirements
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors.
Commitment: ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget.
Learning + application: can demonstrate that basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working.
Interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!

cond_0333.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists with hands-on primary marketing research experience, preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context, who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0333.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and help the team develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To contribute effectively, this individual must be highly analytical, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to share learnings across multiple projects.
Coordinate with team members to manage the research process from start to finish, including developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors.
Contribute initial thinking and frameworks that support the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and work alongside the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Help keep multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, flag issues early, and solve problems together.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ambiguous or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to give and receive constructive feedback to improve shared performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0333.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research experience, including managing the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting
Knowledge of quantitative methodologies and experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate impactful consumer insights through thought-provoking headlines
Attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture — able to manage the little things that have a large impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors
Commitment: ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and ensure reliable results on time and on budget
Preferred Requirements
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business goals and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable
Learning and application: can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater responsibility
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.)
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!

cond_0350.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. You'll own a demonstrable track record and bring hands-on primary marketing research experience — preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context — with the analytical depth and growth mindset to shape actionable insights from complex data.
cond_0350.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will lead primary quantitative research as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams, driving clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation goals forward. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and set the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To succeed, you must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Own the research process end to end — from developing surveys based on client objectives, through testing programs, to managing fieldwork and vendors alongside other team members.
Deliver initial thinking and frameworks that drive compelling, visual report narratives built for insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Lead analytic plan development and direct the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget, applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Proactively advise clients in close coordination with senior team members and account leads — thinking ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of issues, and resolve problems decisively.
Maintain calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating ambiguous or difficult client situations.
Act as an effective peer collaborator and a mentor to junior strategists, taking ownership of giving and receiving constructive feedback to raise performance.
Drive contributions to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0350.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research: experience managing the full market research cycle, including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Quantitative methodologies: knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business needs and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Attention to detail: able to manage the small details that have a large impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project, without losing sight of the big picture.
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors.
Preferred Requirements
Commitment: ability to leverage available resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and deliver reliable results on time and on budget.
Learning and application: can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater autonomous responsibility.
Interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, taking initiative to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
